_comment: The signing identity every published ClearCut release must carry.
Android refuses an in-place update when the signing certificate changes, and
ClearCut's projects live in app-private storage, so a fingerprint change strands
every installed user. The release build fails when the resolved signing key does
not produce this fingerprint, rather than silently falling back to the debug key.
This is a self-signed key: no CA, no EV certificate, no Play App Signing, no
notarization. Only the certificate digest is recorded here -- never the keystore,
subject: C=US, O=Android, CN=Android Debug
